description: PortfolioFragment is a Fragment in an Android application that displays a user's portfolio and its associated data. It utilizes ViewModels and LiveData to observe the UI state and manage user interactions.

classes.name: PortfolioFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages and displays the portfolio of a user, allowing add/edit functionalities.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the Fragment and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView, observes the UI state, and configures the add button.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView with a PortfolioAdapter.

methods.name: observeUiState
methods.description: Observes the UI state from the view model and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updatePortfolioUI
methods.description: Updates the UI elements with the portfolio data based on the current state.

methods.name: setupAddButton
methods.description: Configures the button for adding new portfolio items.

methods.name: showAddPortfolioItemDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for the user to add a new portfolio item.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the view binding when the Fragment's view is destroyed.
